items.title: Citigroup: S&P 500 rose in 13 of 14 cases three months after VIX hit 40

extra.hover: 【Citigroup: S&P 500 rose in 13 of 14 cases three months after VIX hit 40】The VIX recently climbed to around 40, its highest since the April 2025 tariff selloff, Citigroup Wealth Management said. In 13 of the past 14 instances when the index reached 40, the S&P 500 gained over the following three and six months.

items.title: China lithium hydroxide futures debut; listing benchmark seen in line with expectations

extra.hover: 【China lithium hydroxide futures debut; listing benchmark seen in line with expectations】Guangzhou Futures Exchange’s sixth contract, lithium hydroxide futures, began trading Nov. 26. Analysts said the initial listing benchmarks were reasonable: the benchmark was 1,750 yuan/mt below the Nov. 25 spot price of 76,750 yuan/mt. The first-listed contract, LI2706, reflects expected supply and demand in June 2027 rather than current spot conditions, one analyst said. Lithium carbonate and lithium hydroxide prices remain within cost-conversion constraints, while hydroxide’s demand outlook is weaker, with high-nickel demand growth subdued and solid-state batteries not yet at scale. Hydroxide smelting capacity is ample. Based on the Nov. 25 close of the lithium carbonate January 2027 futures contract and the hydroxide listing benchmark, the futures spread was about 7,600 yuan/mt; the spot spread was about 9,150 yuan/mt.

items.title: Persian Gulf oil exports remain under pressure as crude prices reprice geopolitical risk

extra.hover: 【Persian Gulf oil exports remain under pressure as crude prices reprice geopolitical risk】Oil prices steadied early Thursday after rising for two straight sessions, as ongoing military conflict in the Middle East threatened a recovery in regional crude exports and raised concerns over supply disruptions. WTI hovered near $84 a barrel after gaining more than 4% over the previous two sessions. Brent settled below $95. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have continued, including on Ras Tanura, a major oil export hub. Iran also said two tankers transiting the Strait of Hormuz struck mines on Nov. 25. “As long as the conflict remains unresolved, crude prices should retain some risk premium,” said Ryan McKay, senior commodity strategist at TD Securities, adding that Persian Gulf oil exports have declined following repeated Iranian attacks. Trading is expected to be thin on Thursday due to the Thanksgiving holiday.

items.title: Trump officials briefly considered using Cold War law to reinstate Huang

extra.hover: 【Trump officials briefly considered using Cold War law to reinstate Huang】Pentagon leaders briefly considered invoking the Defense Production Act to pressure Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO during discussions last weekend, the Washington Post reported, citing three people familiar with the matter. The Cold War-era law gives the president broad powers to intervene in the economy. Officials said restoring Huang was vital to U.S. national security, but Nvidia’s board did not view the remarks as threats. Trump and Vice President JD Vance increasingly recognized Nvidia’s importance to the U.S. economy and Huang’s role in stabilizing financial markets, two people familiar with the discussions said.
